name: Digital Asset Review Rubric
purpose: Demonstrates how simulation assets are judged for AI rendering, gameplay readability, and production polish.

criteria.description: Assets must remain recognizable from the review camera and during agent motion.
Color, roughness, metallic response, and emissive accents communicate function without labels.
Asset scale and clearance must support autonomous steering without visual ambiguity.
The asset should produce meaningful inspection or perception events for AI evaluation.
Procedural assets should read well while staying lightweight enough for interactive iteration.
